questions.prompt: What was Allen Iverson's scoring average during his 2000–01 MVP season?
questions.note: 31.1 a night, enough to lead the league and win MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: All-Star guard Allen Iverson averaged 31.1 points, 4.6 assists and 2.5 steals per game

funFacts.text: Iverson led the NBA not only in scoring but also in steals that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading the league in both scoring and steals

funFacts.text: Iverson also won All-Star Game MVP in Washington, D.C., where the East beat the West by a single point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iverson scored 25 points along with 5 assists and 4 steals, and was named the All-Star Game Most Valuable Player

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had an unusual awards sweep: teammate Aaron McKie was Sixth Man of the Year and Mutombo was Defensive Player of the Year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Aaron McKie provided the team with 11.6 points, 5.0 assists and 1.4 steals per game, and was named the NBA Sixth Man of the Year

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Walter Davis average for Phoenix in 1983–84?
questions.note: 5.5 assists per game from the veteran guard.

funFacts.text: Davis scored twenty points a game that year.
He started seventy of his seventy-eight appearances.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Walter Davis | 78 | 70 | 32.6

funFacts.text: Davis hit 86.3 percent of his free throws.

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 1994 East finals at Madison Square Garden, how many fourth-quarter points did Reggie Miller score?
questions.context: 1994 East finals · Game 5 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 39 points (25 in the fourth quarter alone) in the Pacers' 93–86 victory

funFacts.text: Director Spike Lee was seated courtside at Madison Square Garden, and Miller talked animatedly at him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: engaged in an animated discussion of his ongoing performance with noted Knicks fan Spike Lee

funFacts.text: That explosive road performance put the Pacers ahead in the series, but the Knicks ultimately eliminated Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: but they lost the next two games and the series

funFacts.text: The player later earned the nickname 'Knick Killer' for his repeated postseason torment of New York.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: most notably against the New York Knicks, for which he earned the nickname "Knick Killer"

questions.prompt: In March 2001, Toronto set what was then the NBA record for team blocks in a game. How many?
questions.note: 23, an NBA record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Raptors combined for 23 blocks, an NBA record at the time

funFacts.text: Toronto reserve Keon Clark supplied the biggest share of the swats despite not starting against Atlanta.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Keon Clark  | Toronto Raptors  | March 23, 2001

funFacts.text: Clark astonishingly committed no personal fouls while sending shot after shot away.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Did not commit a personal foul; holds the NBA record for most blocks

funFacts.text: The Raptors' defensive masterpiece came against the Atlanta Hawks in a comfortable win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Atlanta Hawks  | 112–86
